notes.title: Release Date and Price Reveal
notes.notes:
After a long time without posting, I'm excited to announce the release date and price.

[b]Date: April 24th.[/b]

About the price...

It's pretty common for simulators to cost between $10 and $15, which is fine, but since this is my first simulator game and I don't want the price to be a deal breaker for you, [b]the price will be $6.99 MINUS a generous launch discount[/b], which won't go below that for a long time.

For those interested in the differences between the demo and the final game:
- New recipes
- New monsters
- New appliances
- New ingredients
- Random events added
- New tasks
- New customizations
- Farming has been cut from the game (I know, it's a shame, but I didn't share anything about farming before because it wasn't good enough. Plus, I don't want to put something in the game just to increase the hours)

I appreciate all the support,
Bruno Bricchi

notes.title: German translation, refrigerator and bug fixes
notes.notes:
I made small updates every week to fix small bugs and now this is the biggest update for the demo, just before the Steam Next Fest, here's what's new:

- Deutsch (German) Translation

- Refrigerator that can store up to 10 ready-made packages of each recipe

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266199/be9a1ebfc9360cf60b662cf13b177a56457e41b2.png[/img]

- 3 New options to customize your fast food (you can see the sci-fi one in the screenshot above)

And for the most important bug fixes and smaller additions (some of which I fixed weeks ago, but I'm talking about it now):

- Tutorial objective switching is now faster
- Burger meat sliding and falling behind grill is fixed
- Sound feedback when you delivers a wrong order
- Freezer egg count not being saved has been fixed
- Mug price fixed

notes.title: Playtest Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266199/b13a649aa30351d9373c8bc221c84f262012013a.png[/img]

1,174 people clicked the button to take part in the playtest - and I'm very happy about that!

Some people have messaged me to get access, but the truth is that it's not available at the moment, only the button to request access is (in fact, Steam has already approved the build for the test, but it's not ready yet).

The playtest is planned to be released early December, to be more specific, I'll release it anywhere between the first and second week of December.

In addition, I'll be launching the public demo sometime in January and I'm planning to do this with more content than the playtest. 

At the moment, the playtest has between 1.5 and 2 hours of content.

I'll be back when it's time to launch, thanks!

[b]For content creators: [/b]Videos and posts about the game are totally allowed and I'm preparing a press kit to be released alongside the playtest.

- Bruno Bricchi
